title: Finite Galois image of the radical-fixing subgroup
statement: Let R be a strictly henselian DVR, K its fraction field, E a separable closure, and p its residue characteristic exponent. Fix a uniformizer π and a compatible family of roots α_d in E with α_d^d=π for every positive d coprime to p. For every finite normal intermediate field L/K in E, the image of the subgroup fixing every α_d under restriction Gal(E/K)→Gal(L/K) is a p-group. When p=1 the image is trivial.

source.place: Tags 0BUA and 0BUB; uniformizer radicals and tame kernel; compare ILO Expose XVII section 1.2, printed page 259.

proof.text: The normalization B of R in L is finite Dedekind, not a field, and has fraction field L. Connected integral henselian permanence gives a strictly henselian local structure, a local map R→B and algebraic residue extension. The local Dedekind characterization makes B a DVR.

The residue extension is purely inseparable over the separably closed base field. Uniqueness of algebra embeddings makes every automorphism residue-trivial. Write π=u w^e and e=q n with q the p-primary part (q=1 if p=1). Hensel lifting gives b^n=u, hence β=b w^q is an nth root of π. The root count over R shows β/α_n is fixed, so all radical-fixing automorphisms fix β.

If g(w)=a w, reduction of g(β)=β gives residue(a)^q=1. Frobenius injectivity gives residue(a)=1 in positive characteristic, and q=1 gives it in characteristic zero. For nonidentity g, write g(c)-c=w^i v with v a unit and telescope over orderOf g. Cancel w^i and reduce to show residue characteristic divides orderOf g. Cauchy then makes the finite image a p-group; in characteristic zero this contradicts positive finite order and proves triviality.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0BUA and 0BUB, with the direct Hensel-unit-root and telescoping specialization of more-algebra.tex Tag 09EE, written in the Lean helper docstrings.

theorem finite_radical_restriction_p_group
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsDiscreteValuationRing R]
    [IsStrictlyHenselianLocalRing R]
    (K : Type v) [Field K] [Algebra R K] [IsFractionRing R K]
    (Ksep : Type w) [Field Ksep] [Algebra K Ksep] [IsSepClosure K Ksep]
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p = if ringChar (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) = 0 then 1
      else ringChar (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R))
    (π : R) (hπ : Irreducible π) (α : TameRoots.Order p → Ksep)
    (hα : ∀ d : TameRoots.Order p,
      α d ^ d.1 = algebraMap K Ksep (algebraMap R K π))
    (_hαc : ∀ d e : TameRoots.Order p, d.1 ∣ e.1 → α e ^ (e.1 / d.1) = α d)
    (L : IntermediateField K Ksep) [FiniteDimensional K L] [Normal K L] :
    IsPGroup p (((AlgEquiv.restrictNormalHom L).comp
      (⨅ d : TameRoots.Order p, MulAction.stabilizer Gal(Ksep/K) (α d)).subtype).range)
